reportedIssues: The second card in “Popular right now” shows a promotion badge reading “−100%”. A 100% discount implies the item is free, which is almost certainly invalid promo data (or a sign/formatting bug) and undermines trust in the offers shown.

The favorite (heart) button is inconsistent between cards: on the ramen card it is a bare white outline sitting directly on the photo, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular scrim behind it. On light imagery the bare icon would be hard to see.

Cards in “Fastest near you” show only name and delivery fee, while “Popular right now” cards show rating, time, fee and cuisine. The missing rating/cuisine metadata makes the two rows feel inconsistent and gives users less decision information in the first row.
The search field placeholder “Restaurants, dishes, groceries” is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving low contrast that may fail WCAG 1.4.3 for users with low vision.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 flags the −100% promotion badge on the second Popular right now card as invalid promo data, matching the expected defect.
